notes.title: Falling in Love! Release time update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, good evening!
🔔 Due to the discovery of a competitor on Steam on August 8th, our team has decided that 'Falling in Love!' will be released early on August 6th, 2024 at 18:06. Thank you all for your support, patience, and companionship throughout this journey!
Due to our technical limitations, we are unable to support the development of a complete storyline tree. However, we will provide the official game mainline timeline, specific story synopsis, and achievement system, which we will patch and update later.
One week after the release, we will hold a related community activity where players can piece together a complete storyline through the game and its main storyline. Those who come close will receive prizes. Please look forward to the specific prizes!
Thank you again for your patience over the past few months. We will release the relevant sales link tomorrow. See you at 18:06 on August 6th. Thank you!
